_about: Rendered into the Projects section of index.html by js/home.js. status is 'active' (hosted right now: the card links to `live`) or 'past' (the card links to `post` if there is a blog post, otherwise `repo`, otherwise `paper`). To take a project down from the VPS, change its status to 'past' and add a `post` or `repo` link. In `description`, *word* renders as emphasis.

projects.name: Mememaker
projects.description: An AI meme maker that picks a real, well-known meme template for your situation and writes the captions, instead of generating an image from scratch.

projects.name: OEM Data Simulator
projects.description: Realistic vehicle telemetry simulator for the Motorq Hackathon — emulates speed, fuel, GPS, and tire pressure across diverse driving scenarios using the SUMO engine and TraCI API.
projects.note: Plug in your traffic conditions, routes, and topography, hit go, and out comes realistic vehicle telemetry at whatever sampling frequency you need — no actual car required.

projects.name: AI Architectural Workflows
projects.description: End-to-end AI system generating 2D floorplans and photorealistic interior designs from natural language prompts. Evaluated GPT-3.5, Llama 3, and Mistral. Published in *IEEE CVMI 2024*.

projects.name: Real-Time Quiz App
projects.description: Microservice-based quiz platform with a Go backend, goroutines, JWT authentication, PostgreSQL storage, and WebSocket support for real-time updates. React/TypeScript frontend.
projects.note: At work, we toss around terms like Microservices, Kubernetes, gRPC, and Docker like they cost nothing — because a brilliant DevSecOps team quietly abstracts all this away. This project was a way for me to understand all this on a deeper level: turns out, making distributed systems not fall apart at 2 AM is genuinely hard work :)
